comparison_rule: At every rate, DAA-V2, raw global HGB, and GbV use exactly the same total action count and their own pre-label sealed ranking scores.
interpretation: This grid is frozen before fresh-label access. It is secondary descriptive recovery-damage operating-point evidence and cannot replace the primary 5.0% result.
engineering_frontier_target: DAA-V2 should have higher net correction than GbV with no more damage at at least 4 of the 5 frozen rates. This is not a familywise-controlled hypothesis test.
